# How to use this site {#instructions}

**Welcome! On this site you will:**

* Learn the key elements of confidence intervals
* Clear up common misconceptions
* Explore confidence intervals with interactive graphs

Work through the pages in order using the sidebar or the arrows at the bottom.
Whenever you see a <span style="color: purple;">**purple term**</span>, it links back to the [glossary](#glossary).
